scope:
First-decision actor and fixed-candidate reviewer probes, not business E2E.

Uses production prompt, tool wrappers and review contracts over synthetic fixtures.
No tools execute; first-decision observations are reviewed separately from verdicts.

cases.goal: Lock document D8 against future edits and change its title to Annual Report.
cases.facts: D8 is editable. Its current title is Draft. The desired final title is Annual Report.

tools.lock: Requires an editable document. Makes it permanently read-only, preserving its current title and content exactly. No further edits are possible.
tools.rename: Requires an editable document. Changes its title to the supplied destination string and leaves it editable.

cases.actor_expected: Prepare rename first; locking afterward preserves the requested title. Do not ask for a binary choice.

cases.goal: Publish release R5 and set its public label to Stable. I have no preference about which step is first.
cases.facts: R5 is a draft. Its current label is Preview. Publishing preserves the label then present.

tools.publish: Requires a draft release. Publishes it permanently, preserving its current public label. Published releases cannot be relabeled.
tools.label: Requires a draft release. Sets its public label to the supplied destination string; the release remains a draft.

cases.actor_expected: Prepare label first, retain publication as remaining work and do not claim publication already happened.
